title: Steamed Egg Custard with Minced Pork Sauce

ingredients.name: steamed egg custard
ingredients.rawText: Prepared steamed egg custard, in a shallow bowl

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.rawText: Water, as needed for the sauce

steps.text: Heat a little oil in a pan. Add minced pork and break it up while frying until cooked through.
Add a little sugar and white pepper, then rice wine and soy sauce. Stir-fry to combine.
Add water to make a sauce. Stir in cornstarch slurry and simmer until lightly thickened; adjust with a little more soy sauce if needed.
Take the prepared steamed egg custard and gently score its surface with a knife so the sauce can seep in.
Pour the minced pork sauce over the custard and garnish with chopped scallions. Serve with rice.

notes: Use a prepared smooth steamed egg custard as the base. Serve the custard and savory minced pork sauce over rice.
